candidates.title: 11 hours shifts, no job security: Life of Hyderabad gig workers
candidates.excerpt: Hyderabad: Nikhil fills paper bags for orders at a Zepto store in Hyderabad’s Miyapur. One afternoon he lay down during his break. “I took a nap during my break, and my manager deemed that reason enough to suppress my ID,” said Nikhil. Suppressing an ID means a worker’s login stops working. No login, no shifts, no …

candidates.title: In India’s capital, Delhiites reduced to documents
candidates.excerpt: Across SIR hearing centres in the national capital, people are making repeated trips, producing documents, and waiting for hours to prove their eligibility, often despite having voted for years. Ishita Mishra and Suruchi Kumari spoke to people appealing to retain their right to vote and officials who share the reality of a process marked by confusion. As always, the burden to prove their identity is falling hardest on society’s poorer, less-documented voter
